title: QUANTITATIVE METHODS IN PSYCHOLOGICAL SCIENCE
description: Explores quantitative methods in psychological science, including descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, correlation, one-way or two-way ANOVA, and regression. Discusses controversies and emerging practices in open psychological science. Examines methods of data reporting and visualization.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: PSY 297.
A minimum grade of C- is required in PSY 297.
